name: RE_SERVE
source:
You are a simple bartender, stuck behind an empty bar, watching bodies move in tandem with the music on the dance floor. 

What begins as a regular shift changes as a strange and captivating woman takes the seat in front of you. You should serve her a drink, you know which one?

[From [url=https://elduator.itch.io/reserve]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个简单的调酒师，被困在一个空酒吧后面，看着舞池里的身体随着音乐一起移动。

当一个陌生而迷人的女人坐在你面前时，一开始的常规轮班发生了变化。你应该给她倒一杯酒，你知道是哪一杯吗？

[来自[url=https://elduator.itch.io/reserve]itch.io[/url]]
